pr254RelevantReviewComments.body: Fixed in `78ced7f3`: the dock's notes stand in one stack (`.dock-notes`, a grid with an 8 px gap, each line its own height): above the floating dock, under the header's (`top: calc(100% + 10px)`, 240 px wide there). A wrapping error pushes her looking down by its own height; the two fixed offsets are gone. dock-header.spec reads the stack under the header holding the looking note. Lint, typecheck, the node tests and contracts:check are clean; the browser specs could not be run locally for this commit (the machine guard refused to start Playwright beside a heavy app), so CI is the run on record for them.

Fixed in `78ced7f3`: the Conversations cover makes inert only the docks the panel covers, the floating one, never `.topbar .mini-dock`, which stands above the panel. dock-header.spec at 1000 px opens the context and reads the list inert, the header dock not, its Join enabled. Lint, typecheck, the node tests and contracts:check are clean; the browser specs could not be run locally for this commit (the machine guard refused to start Playwright beside a heavy app), so CI is the run on record for them.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Move focus before making the relocated dock inert**

When the Conversations context is open and focus is on a live header-dock control, resizing from 721 px or wider to 720 px or narrower causes `useDockFocus` to restore focus to the newly mounted floating control before this animation-frame callback makes that dock inert. Focus is consequently left inside an inert subtree or discarded to the document body instead of moving into the still-open context panel. Fresh evidence beyond the earlier focus thread is this ordering between layout-effect focus restoration and the delayed cover; redirect focus to the panel before covering the relocated dock.
